text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both climbing modestly, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin's gains, suggesting some rotation into altcoin risk despite extreme fear conditions. Bitcoin dominance holding at 58.7% and total volume at $58B indicate cautious participation rather than panic capitulation. The Fear & Greed index remains at 11—near historical lows—which often precedes stabilization or early recovery phases, though conviction remains weak across the market.
